- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended resources include:
  - Fair Trade USA: Certifies and promotes fair trade products with a directory of certified products and retailers.
  - Good on You: An app that rates fashion brands on labor practices, environmental impact, and animal welfare.
  - Shop Ethical!: An app that rates companies on ethical and environmental criteria in over 22 categories.
  - The Better World Shopper: A website that rates companies on social and environmental impact, offering guides for ethical product purchasing.
